title: When the Locker Wakes
author: Mirabel Sterling
blurb: Elodie Amberdale, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before the last game of the season.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
